apps.localizedDescription:
Own your crypto future with Exodus, the world's leading all-in-one crypto and bitcoin wallet.

Exodus is self-custodial which means only YOU control your wallet. No one at Exodus ever has access to your funds. We never ask for your 12-word phrase and never offer support outside our official email support@exodus.com.

Key Features:

Effortless Crypto Transfers
Easily send and receive crypto across 50+ networks, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), and more. Manage custom tokens and explore DeFi, NFTs, and Web3 applications and dApps — all within one secure crypto app.
